sections.Profile:
The "Lazy-Q" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in December 1953, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1953
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Western, Wood Rail, Horses, Original Theme
